mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings slowdowns, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that pressures corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during manufacturing slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month RSAFS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as policy shifts toward hawkishness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 1600.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 0.5% and unemployment rate above 6.0% signal dual monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
